text: Hands down one of the best barbershops I've been to. Got my cut with Jesus (Mr. Iconic) and he absolutely delivered. The fade was sharp, the beard lineup perfectly detailed. He takes pride in his craft. Highly recommended.
name: Ricardo Zambrano

text: I've been getting my haircuts with Ben for a while now and every single experience has been incredible. He is detail-oriented and takes his time to tailor the cut exactly to what I'm asking for. You can tell he genuinely takes honor in his craft.
name: Manuel Sarria

text: Fresh cuts, clean shop, and great attention to detail. Dionis really takes his time and makes sure you leave looking right. Definitely my new go-to barber. Highly recommend!
name: Matt Alban

text: Great experience at this shop. Great barbers and everyone is welcoming. My guy TY keeps me on point.
name: Andell Brown

text: I can't describe how amazing my experience here has been. Everyone here is professional and friendly. Oscar you are the best. Dionis thanks 🙏
name: Waldemar Winkler

text: Thank you for the great staff and for the best barber shop owner Dionis Cutz. They have the best barbers — come check them out, you won't be disappointed.
name: Joey Zelaya

text: Excelente, genial, 20/10. Lo mejor que le regalé a mi novio y se cortó el cabello con Iconic.
name: Hernax Moreno

text: Desde que entras se siente un ambiente sofisticado y acogedor. Quiero destacar al barbero Lucho, sin duda uno de los mejores en Miami. Su dedicación al detalle hace que cada corte sea una verdadera obra de arte.
name: Jorge Glez

text: Every haircut here is superb. My son and I always go back here and get good haircut and awesome service. Ben is the hairmaster we trust.
name: Eman Bondoc

text: I've gotten 2 haircuts and honestly the best service you can ask for. Surrounded by top tier barbers there's no doubt you'll find a barber for you.
name: Carlos Calderon

text: I came in for a new cut and Lucho (Station #2) is the man for the job! Not only did he accomplish what I wanted but he went above and beyond. I came out a new man! 100% always recommend Lucho.
name: Steven Rojo

text: Very good service. I have been coming to the barbershop for a long time. Miami's best barbers are in Dionis Cutz 💪
name: Hamilton Turizo

text: I visited Dionis Cutz for the first time and I'll definitely be going back. Tranquil environment, excellent music, and polite and skilled barbers. I left feeling more content than ever after a clean cut from Dionis himself. He exceeded my expectations.
name: Luz Salgado

text: Every time I go to Dionis Cutz I feel brand new. I get compliments on how the cut and fade are done so impeccable. Great quality, unbeatable pricing, friendly staff. By far my favorite barber shop in the city.
name: Kris Alex

text: As soon as you enter all of the barbers greet you with a smile, fist bump and high five. The place is organized and clean and my haircut? Man oh man… love it.
name: Allan Rabara

text: I've been coming to this barber for 8 years and watched it grow. Dionis made this place bloom from what was average to a great environment to cut your hair at. A five star barber for sure.
name: Julio Lara
